  1450	        }
  1451	        const cursor = await verifyRecoveryCursorBody(github, signedBody);
  1452	        if (cursor) verified.push({ sourceVariableName: variable.name, signedBody, cursor });
  1453	        else sourceFullyVerified = false;
  1454	      }
  1455	      // A readable pack is rewrite-safe only when every member revalidates. Valid siblings remain
  1456	      // readable for winner selection, but a transiently unverifiable sibling quarantines the whole
  1457	      // source from rename/delete/compaction so its only durable copy cannot be destroyed.
  1458	      if (sourceFullyVerified) compactableSources.add(variable.name);
  1459	      continue;
  1460	    }
  1461	    const cursor = await verifyRecoveryCursorBody(github, variable.value);
  1462	    if (!cursor || recoveryCursorBucket(cursor) !== bucket) {
  1463	      // Verification can fail transiently (for example while provenance/JWKS reads are unavailable).
  1464	      // This protected source may be the sole committed witness, so never delete it on read failure.
  1465	      continue;
  1466	    }
  1467	    verified.push({ sourceVariableName: variable.name, signedBody: variable.value, cursor });
  1468	    compactableSources.add(variable.name);
  1469	  }
  1470	  return { entries: verified, compactableSources };

  1473	async function captureRecoveryReadEpoch(github: FugueGitHub): Promise<string> {
  1474	  if (await recoverInterruptedRecoveryMutation(github)) {
  1475	    throw new DurableProtocolRecoveryPendingError("Protected recovery mutation is still provisional; committed authority remains fenced.");
  1476	  }
  1477	  const epoch = await ensureRecoveryMutationGuardIdle(github);
  1478	  if (!epoch || (await activeRecoveryMutationGuards(github)).length ||
  1479	      await getFugueAuthorityVariable(github, RECOVERY_MUTATION_GUARD_IDLE) !== epoch) {
  1480	    throw new DurableProtocolRecoveryPendingError("Protected recovery authority changed while the reader was starting.");
  1481	  }
  1482	  return epoch;
  1483	}
  1484	
  1485	async function assertRecoveryReadEpoch(github: FugueGitHub, epoch: string): Promise<void> {
  1486	  if ((await activeRecoveryMutationGuards(github)).length ||
  1487	      await getFugueAuthorityVariable(github, RECOVERY_MUTATION_GUARD_IDLE) !== epoch) {
  1488	    throw new DurableProtocolRecoveryPendingError(
  1489	      "Protected recovery authority changed during the read; retry from a fresh committed epoch.",
  1490	    );
  1491	  }
  1492	}
  1493	
  1494	async function findRecoveryCursorForPublisher(
  1495	  github: FugueGitHub,
  1496	  options: RecoveryIdentityOptions,
  1497	): Promise<{ variableName: string; cursor: RecoveryCursor } | undefined> {
  1498	  let lastPending: DurableProtocolRecoveryPendingError | undefined;
  1499	  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < RECOVERY_COMPACTION_RETRY_LIMIT; attempt += 1) {
  1500	    try { return await findRecoveryCursor(github, options); }
  1501	    catch (error) {
  1502	      if (!(error instanceof DurableProtocolRecoveryPendingError)) throw error;
  1503	      lastPending = error;
  1504	      await Promise.resolve();
  1505	    }
  1506	  }
  1507	  throw lastPending ?? new DurableProtocolRecoveryPendingError("Protected recovery authority remained busy during publication.");
  1508	}
  1509	
  1510	async function findRecoveryCursor(
  1511	  github: FugueGitHub,
  1512	  options: RecoveryIdentityOptions,
  1513	): Promise<{ variableName: string; cursor: RecoveryCursor } | undefined> {
  1514	  const readEpoch = await captureRecoveryReadEpoch(github);
  1515	  const identity = recoveryOptionsIdentity(options);
  1516	  let best: VerifiedRecoveryEntry | undefined;
  1517	  const variables = await listFugueAuthorityVariables(github, "FUGUE_D3");
  1518	  const bucket = await verifiedRecoveryEntriesForBucket(github, recoveryOptionsBucket(options), variables);
  1519	  for (const entry of bucket.entries) {
  1520	    if (recoveryIdentity(entry.cursor) !== identity) continue;
  1521	    if (best && recoveryAuthorityConflict(entry.cursor, best.cursor)) {
  1522	      await assertRecoveryReadEpoch(github, readEpoch);
  1523	      throw new CanonicalWorkStateIntegrityError(
  1524	        `Conflicting protected durable witnesses share one authority order for ${options.scope}.`,
  1525	      );
  1526	    }
  1527	    if (!best || compareRecoveryProgress(entry.cursor, best.cursor) > 0 ||
  1528	        (compareRecoveryProgress(entry.cursor, best.cursor) === 0 &&
  1529	          recoveryBodyTieBreak(entry.signedBody) < recoveryBodyTieBreak(best.signedBody))) {
  1530	      best = entry;
  1531	    }
  1532	  }
  1533	  await assertRecoveryReadEpoch(github, readEpoch);
  1534	  return best ? { variableName: best.sourceVariableName, cursor: best.cursor } : undefined;
  1535	}

   790	  }), anchorBody))) {
   791	    await abandonIntegrationAuthorization(github, authorized.electionName, authorized.request);
   792	    return { dispatch: false };
   793	  }
   794	
   795	  let afterElection = await getCurrentIntegrationRecord(github, snapshot.identity);
   796	  const predecessorStillCurrent = predecessorRequestId
   797	    ? afterElection?.request.request_id === predecessorRequestId && afterElection.terminal?.state === "aborted"
   798	    : afterElection === undefined;
   799	  if (afterElection && afterElection.request.request_id === authorized.request.request_id && !afterElection.terminal) {
   800	    // A concurrent protected writer already published the elected request; converge on it.
   801	  } else if (!predecessorStillCurrent) {
   802	    await abandonIntegrationAuthorization(github, authorized.electionName, authorized.request);
   803	    return afterElection ? { request: afterElection.request, dispatch: false } : { dispatch: false };
   804	  } else {
   805	    afterElection = await publishIntegrationRecord(github, createIntegrationRecord(authorized.request, {
   806	      dispatch: authorized.authorization,
   807	      createdAt: authorized.authorization.authorized_at,
   808	    }));
   809	  }
   810	  const confirmed = await getCurrentIntegrationRecord(github, snapshot.identity);
   811	  if (!confirmed || confirmed.request.request_id !== authorized.request.request_id || confirmed.terminal) {
   812	    await abandonIntegrationAuthorization(github, authorized.electionName, authorized.request);
   813	    return confirmed ? { request: confirmed.request, dispatch: false } : { dispatch: false };
   814	  }
   815	  await retireIntegrationElection(github, authorized.electionName);
   816	  await createProtocolComment(
   817	    github,
   818	    snapshot.identity.prNumber,
   819	    `INTEGRATION — REQUESTED\n\nHead: \`${snapshot.identity.headSha}\`\nRequest: \`${authorized.request.request_id}\`\n\n<!-- fugue-integration-request-mirror\nversion: 1\nrequest_id: ${authorized.request.request_id}\n-->`,
   820	  );
   821	  return {
   822	    request: confirmed.request,
   823	    dispatch: true,
   824	    dispatchSecret: authorized.secret,
   825	    authorityAnchor: authorized.authorization.anchor_name,
   826	  };
   827	}
   828	
   829	export async function bindIntegrationRun(
   830	  github: FugueGitHub,
   831	  snapshot: EvaluationSnapshot,
   832	  requestId: string,
   833	  runId: number,
   834	): Promise<IntegrationRecord> {
   835	  const current = await getCurrentIntegrationRecord(github, snapshot.identity);
   836	  if (!current || current.request.request_id !== requestId || current.terminal) {
   837	    throw new Error(`Integration run ${runId} does not match an active durable request ${requestId}.`);
   838	  }
   839	  if (current.run) {
   840	    if (current.run.id !== runId) throw new Error(`Integration request ${requestId} is already bound to protected run ${current.run.id}.`);
   841	    await releaseIntegrationAuthorityVariable(github, current);
   842	    return current;
   843	  }
   844	  const evidence = await getIntegrationRunStartEvidence(github, current);
   845	  if (!evidence || evidence.run_id !== runId) {
   846	    throw new Error(`Integration run ${runId} does not match the one-use protected dispatch evidence for request ${requestId}.`);
   847	  }
   848	  const bound = await publishIntegrationRecord(github, {
   849	    ...current,
   850	    run: integrationRunBindingFromEvidence(github, evidence),
   851	    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
   852	  });
   853	  await releaseIntegrationAuthorityVariable(github, bound);
   854	  return bound;
   855	}
   856	
   857	export async function bindDispatchedIntegrationRun(
   858	  github: FugueGitHub,
   859	  snapshot: EvaluationSnapshot,
   860	  requestId: string,
   861	  runId: number,
   862	  htmlUrl: string,
   863	  createdAt = new Date().toISOString(),
   864	): Promise<IntegrationRecord> {
   865	  if (!Number.isInteger(runId) || runId <= 0 || !htmlUrl) throw new Error("Protected Integration dispatch did not return a valid run identity.");
   866	  const current = await getCurrentIntegrationRecord(github, snapshot.identity);
   867	  if (!current || current.request.request_id !== requestId || current.terminal || !current.dispatch) {
   868	    throw new Error(`Integration run ${runId} does not match an active authorized durable request ${requestId}.`);
   869	  }
   870	  if (current.run) {
